entities.name: Outer Sea
entities.description: The only known part of the ocean on Mercadia, east of Rushwood, with Rishada on its coast.

entities.name: Mercadia
entities.description: The plane containing the Outer Sea.

entities.name: Captain El-Halal
entities.description: Captain who led the crew to retrieve a golden leaf from the Isle of the Gilded Tree.

entities.name: Tap
entities.description: A Mercadian sent on a quest for a golden leaf to win Evangeline's father's blessing.

entities.name: Evangeline's father
entities.description: Father of Evangeline who deceived Tap with an impossible mission.

entities.name: Tidal kraken
entities.description: A massive kraken whose arrival forced the crew to unite.

events.summary: Tap, sailing under El-Halal, found the Isle of the Gilded Tree barren, his mission a deception by Evangeline's father.
events.quote: only to discover that the island was barren

events.summary: A tidal kraken forced the crew to unite and was driven away.
events.quote: the arrival of a massive tidal kraken forces the crew to unite

events.summary: Stranded, the crew found a treasure hoard revealed by the tide, including a gold-leafed goblet that let Tap complete his quest.
events.quote: the receding tide to reveal a hidden treasure hoard

events.summary: The crew returned wealthy and convinced Evangeline's father to bless the union.
events.quote: the crew convinced Evangeline’s father to bless the union

relations.quote: by the father of Tap's beloved
